answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farms at the door. Each epoch the network sells a fixed number of entry seats to the highest bidders, and every admitted agent pays the clearing price, so the network stays a haven for honest work. One honest agent pays 5 POA for a seat and keeps the nectar of its earnings, while an attacker wanting 1000 fake identities must outbid real demand 1000 times, paying 1000 x 5 = 5000 POA up front. Seats cannot be resold below the ledge of the clearing price.
